# 1 Enoch Chapter 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** From the time of the killing and destruction and death of the giants, the spirits that came out of their bodies will continue their campaign of destruction — without facing any judgment — right up until the great final day of reckoning, when the whole age will be brought to its end. That judgment will fall on the Watchers and on all the godless.

**2** Now, regarding the Watchers who sent you to plead on their behalf — those who once lived in heaven — this is what you are to tell them:

**3** 'You lived in heaven, but not all the heavenly mysteries had been disclosed to you. You only knew the lesser, worthless ones. Yet even those you chose to share with women, in the willfulness of your hearts. And through those secrets, women and men have been causing great harm on earth.'

**4** Tell them plainly: 'You will have no peace.'

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 16 wraps up God's verdict with two final charges: the continuing work of evil spirits until the end (v. 1), and the additional sin of revealing unauthorized heavenly knowledge (v. 3). The final punch-line 'You will have no peace' (v. 4) is the same verdict given to Azazel in ch. 13 and echoes the fate of sinners in ch. 5. The dynamic rendering makes the temporal structure of v. 1 clearer by splitting the complex participial clause into a more readable sequence.*
